notes.title: Second Map Announcement
notes.notes:
What do you do if you want to improve but keep losing? What do you do when you aim for the top but keep falling? That's right — you find another, tougher path.

A new route to the top of the mountain is opening soon! Or is it a different mountain entirely? Either way, it’s being closely monitored and inspected by the mountain climbing agency, ensuring all safety measures are in place.

Stay tuned. They promise something special at the top!

notes.title: 1.1 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Boxman's Struggle new update has been released. Update v1.1 fixes some bugs and adds little bit more:

[list]
[*] Escape button will not close the game anymore while in menu.
[*] Increased in-game sound level even more.
[*] Mouse should not leave game screen on dual monitors while game is in focus.
[*] Disabled steam overlay won't prevent unlocking achievements.
[*] Updated some visual effects.
[*] Added in-game tool to report bugs and leave suggestions.
[*] Added new way to quickly fall down and lose progress.
[*] Added one new secret ending.
[*] Added two new achievements.
[*] Fixed some minor bugs.
[/list]

With new update there always is a chance that some bugs might have been missed, so if anybody encounters any problem, it will be fixed soon.
